canNow.en: I can now match the weather words.
canNow.zh: 我现在能配对天气词汇。

intro.en: Remember the pictures: the sponge, the bulldozer, the ramp and the cold drink.
intro.zh: 记住这些画面：海绵、推土机、斜坡和冰饮料。

questions.q: "It is raining in Bangkok today." This is...

why.en: Weather is what the air is like at ONE time and place (today, now). "Today" tells us it is weather, not the long-term pattern (climate).
why.zh: 天气是某一个时间、某一个地方的空气状况（今天、现在）。today 说明是天气，不是长期规律（气候）。

climate.en: Climate is the usual pattern over many years. One rainy day is weather.
climate.zh: 气候是很多年通常的样子。一个下雨天是天气。

an air mass.en: An air mass is a huge body of air. The sentence describes conditions today.
an air mass.zh: 气团是一大团空气。这句话说的是今天的情况。

a front.en: A front is the border between two air masses. The sentence does not mention air meeting.
a front.zh: 锋是两个气团的交界。句子里没有说空气相遇。

questions.q: "Deserts get very little rain every year." This is...

why.en: Climate is the usual weather of a place over many years. "Every year" shows a long-term pattern, so climate.
why.zh: 气候是一个地方很多年通常的天气。every year 表示长期规律，所以是气候。

weather.en: Weather is one day. "Every year" is many years, so it is climate.
weather.zh: 天气是一天的。every year 是很多年，所以是气候。

a front.en: A front is where two air masses meet for a day or two, not a yearly pattern.
a front.zh: 锋是两个气团相遇一两天，不是每年的规律。

condensation.en: Condensation is gas turning into liquid. The sentence is about yearly rainfall.
condensation.zh: 凝结是气体变液体。这句话讲的是每年的雨量。

questions.q: An air mass that formed over a warm ocean is...

why.en: Ocean = maritime (wet). Warm = tropical.
why.zh: 海洋 = maritime（湿）；暖 = tropical。

continental polar.en: Continental = over land (dry) and polar = cold. Both are the opposite of a warm ocean.
continental polar.zh: continental = 陆地（干），polar = 冷。都和温暖的海洋相反。

maritime polar.en: Maritime is right (ocean), but polar means cold. The ocean was warm, so tropical.
maritime polar.zh: maritime（海洋）对了，但 polar 是冷的。海洋是暖的，所以是 tropical。

continental tropical.en: Tropical is right (warm), but continental means over land. It formed over an ocean, so maritime.
continental tropical.zh: tropical（暖）对了，但 continental 是陆地。它在海上形成，所以是 maritime。

questions.q: Continental polar air is...

why.en: Continental = dry. Polar = cold.
why.zh: 大陆的 = 干；极地的 = 冷。

warm and wet.en: That is maritime tropical. Continental = dry, polar = cold.
warm and wet.zh: 那是海洋热带气团。continental = 干，polar = 冷。

hot and dry.en: Dry is right (continental), but polar means cold, not hot.
hot and dry.zh: 干是对的（continental），但 polar 是冷，不是热。

cool and wet.en: Wet comes from maritime (ocean). Continental air formed over land, so it is dry.
cool and wet.zh: 湿来自 maritime（海上）。continental 在陆地上形成，所以是干的。

questions.q: Which air sinks?

why.en: Cold air is DENSER: its particles are packed closer together, so the same space of cold air is heavier. Heavier air sinks, and warm, lighter air rises.
why.zh: 冷空气密度更大：分子挤得更紧，同样大小的冷空气更重。重的空气下沉，暖的轻空气上升。

warm air.en: Warm air is lighter (less dense), so it RISES, like a hot-air balloon.
warm air.zh: 暖空气比较轻（密度小），所以上升，像热气球一样。

both.en: They do opposite things: cold air sinks and warm air rises.
both.zh: 它们正相反：冷空气下沉，暖空气上升。

neither.en: Cold air does sink, because it is heavier than warm air.
neither.zh: 冷空气确实会下沉，因为它比暖空气重。

questions.q: A cold front is like a...

why.en: Cold air shoves warm air up fast.
why.zh: 冷空气把暖空气快速推上去。

ramp.en: The ramp is the WARM front, where warm air slides up gently.
ramp.zh: 斜坡比喻的是暖锋，暖空气慢慢滑上去。

sponge.en: The sponge is an air mass soaking up heat and water.
sponge.zh: 海绵比喻的是气团吸收热和水分。

camera.en: A camera is not one of the weather comparisons.
camera.zh: 相机不是天气里用的比喻。

questions.q: Gentle rain for a long time usually comes with a...

why.en: Warm air slides up slowly: flat clouds, gentle rain.
why.zh: 暖空气慢慢滑上去：平平的云，小雨。

cold front.en: A cold front pushes air up FAST, so the rain is short and heavy, not long and gentle.
cold front.zh: 冷锋把空气快速推上去，所以雨又短又大，不是又长又小。

high pressure area.en: High pressure means sinking air and usually clear skies, not rain.
high pressure area.zh: 高压是空气下沉，通常是晴天，不下雨。

rain shadow.en: A rain shadow is the DRY side of a mountain, with very little rain.
rain shadow.zh: 雨影区是山的干燥一侧，雨很少。

questions.q: Water drops on the outside of a cold drink are caused by...

why.en: Water vapour in the air cools and turns into liquid.
why.zh: 空气里的水蒸气变冷，变成液体。

evaporation.en: Evaporation turns liquid into gas, so water disappears. On the cold drink, water appears.
evaporation.zh: 蒸发是液体变气体，水会消失。冰饮料上的水是出现了。

melting.en: Melting is solid to liquid. The drops come from water vapour in the air, a gas.
melting.zh: 融化是固体变液体。水珠来自空气中的水蒸气（气体）。

erosion.en: Erosion is carrying rock and soil away. It is not about water drops on a glass.
erosion.zh: 侵蚀是把岩石和泥土带走，跟杯子上的水珠无关。

questions.q: Clouds form when warm, wet air...

why.en: High up it is cold, so water vapour condenses into tiny drops.
why.zh: 高空很冷，水蒸气凝结成小水滴。

sinks and warms.en: Sinking, warming air can hold MORE water vapour, so clouds disappear. That is why high pressure is clear.
sinks and warms.zh: 下沉变暖的空气能装更多水蒸气，所以云会消失。所以高压是晴天。

stops moving.en: Still air does not cool down, so no condensation and no clouds.
stops moving.zh: 不动的空气不会变冷，就不会凝结，也就没有云。

turns into ice at once.en: Water vapour first condenses into tiny liquid drops. Only very high, freezing clouds have ice.
turns into ice at once.zh: 水蒸气先凝结成小水滴，只有很高很冷的云里才有冰。

questions.q: Puffy, cotton-ball clouds are...

why.en: Cumulus = puffy. Stratus = flat. Cirrus = wispy.
why.zh: 积云 = 蓬松；层云 = 平；卷云 = 细丝。

stratus.en: Stratus means layer: flat, grey sheets of cloud, not puffy balls.
stratus.zh: stratus 是“层”：扁平的灰色云层，不是一团一团的。

cirrus.en: Cirrus means curl of hair: thin, wispy, high clouds.
cirrus.zh: cirrus 是“卷发”：又细又薄的高云。

nimbus.en: Nimbus means rain cloud: dark and full of rain, not white and puffy.
nimbus.zh: nimbus 是“雨云”：又黑又带雨，不是白白的一团。

canNow.en: I can now explain air masses, fronts and how clouds form.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释气团、锋和云的形成。

title.zh: 课堂小测：方程和不等式（第 8 章）

intro.en: Equations: do the opposite, then check. Inequalities: open or closed circle, left or right.
intro.zh: 方程：做相反的运算，再检查。不等式：空心还是实心，向左还是向右。

questions.q: Is 8 a solution of x + 4 = 12?

why.en: A solution is a number that makes the equation TRUE. Put 8 in place of x: 8 + 4 = 12, and 12 = 12 is true. So yes, 8 is a solution.
why.zh: 解就是让等式成立的数。把 8 代入 x：8 + 4 = 12，12 = 12 成立，所以 8 是解。

No.en: Test it: 8 + 4 = 12, which matches the right side exactly. Because it makes the equation true, 8 IS a solution.
No.zh: 试一下：8 + 4 = 12，和右边一样。它让等式成立，所以 8 是解。

why.en: To get x alone, undo "+ 18" with the inverse operation, "− 18", on BOTH sides: x = 31 − 18 = 13. Check: 13 + 18 = 31 ✓.

49.en: 49 comes from ADDING 18 (31 + 18). To undo + 18 you must subtract. Check: 49 + 18 = 67, not 31.

12.en: Subtraction slip: 31 − 18 is 13, not 12. Check: 12 + 18 = 30, not 31.

18.en: 18 is the number already in the equation, not x. Check: 18 + 18 = 36, not 31.
18.zh: 18 是题目里本来的数，不是 x。检查：18 + 18 = 36，不是 31。

why.en: Undo "− 7" with its inverse, "+ 7", on both sides: m = 25 + 7 = 32. Check: 32 − 7 = 25 ✓.

18.en: 18 comes from subtracting 7 (25 − 7). That does the same operation again instead of undoing it. Check: 18 − 7 = 11, not 25.
18.zh: 18 是又减了 7（25 − 7），没有抵消反而重复了。检查：18 − 7 = 11，不是 25。

25.en: 25 is the answer side, not m. Check: 25 − 7 = 18, not 25.
25.zh: 25 是等号右边的数，不是 m。检查：25 − 7 = 18，不是 25。

7.en: 7 is the number being taken away, not m. Check: 7 − 7 = 0, not 25.
7.zh: 7 是被减去的数，不是 m。检查：7 − 7 = 0，不是 25。

why.en: 6x means 6 × x. The inverse of multiplying by 6 is dividing by 6, so divide both sides: x = 42 ÷ 6 = 7. Check: 6 × 7 = 42 ✓.
why.zh: 6x 就是 6 × x。乘以 6 的逆运算是除以 6，两边都除：x = 42 ÷ 6 = 7。检查：6 × 7 = 42 ✓。

36.en: 36 is 42 − 6. But 6x is multiplication, so undo it by DIVIDING. Check: 6 × 36 = 216.
36.zh: 36 是 42 − 6。但 6x 是乘法，要用除法抵消。检查：6 × 36 = 216。

48.en: 48 is 42 + 6. 6x is multiplication, so divide. Check: 6 × 48 = 288.

252.en: 252 is 42 × 6, which multiplies again instead of undoing. Check: 6 × 252 = 1512.

why.en: The inverse of dividing by 3 is multiplying by 3: y = 12 × 3 = 36. Check: 36 ÷ 3 = 12 ✓.

4.en: 4 is 12 ÷ 3, which divides again instead of undoing. Check: 4 ÷ 3 is not 12.
4.zh: 4 是 12 ÷ 3，又除了一次而没有抵消。检查：4 ÷ 3 不是 12。

15.en: 15 is 12 + 3. The equation has division, so undo it with multiplication. Check: 15 ÷ 3 = 5.
15.zh: 15 是 12 + 3。等式里是除法，要用乘法抵消。检查：15 ÷ 3 = 5。

9.en: 9 is 12 − 3. Undo division with multiplication. Check: 9 ÷ 3 = 3.
9.zh: 9 是 12 − 3。除法要用乘法抵消。检查：9 ÷ 3 = 3。

questions.q: Emma had some stickers and got 8 more. Now she has 20. Which equation fits?

why.en: Turn the words into maths in order: some stickers (s) + got 8 more (+ 8) = now has 20 (= 20). "Got more" means add.
why.zh: 按顺序把文字变成算式：一些贴纸（s）+ 又得到 8 张（+ 8）= 现在有 20 张（= 20）。“得到更多”就是加。

s − 8 = 20.en: Minus means she LOST or gave away 8. She got 8 more, so plus.
s − 8 = 20.zh: 减号表示她失去或送出了 8 张。她是又得到 8 张，所以用加。

8s = 20.en: 8s means 8 TIMES s. She did not get 8 times as many; she got 8 more.
8s = 20.zh: 8s 是 8 乘以 s。她不是变成 8 倍，而是多了 8 张。

s + 20 = 8.en: This says she ends with 8. She ends with 20, so 20 goes alone on the right.
s + 20 = 8.zh: 这表示她最后有 8 张。她最后有 20 张，所以 20 单独放在右边。

questions.q: Which symbol means "at least"?

why.en: "At least 5" means 5 or MORE: 5 is allowed, and so is anything bigger. The symbol that means "greater than OR equal to" is ≥ (the line underneath means "or equal").
why.zh: “至少 5”就是 5 或更多：5 可以，更大的也可以。表示“大于或等于”的符号是 ≥（下面那条线表示“或等于”）。

≤.en: ≤ means less than or equal to: AT MOST, which is the opposite.
≤.zh: ≤ 是小于或等于，也就是“最多”，意思相反。

>.en: >  means greater than, but it does NOT include the number itself. At least includes it, so it needs the line: ≥.
>.zh: > 是大于，但不包括这个数本身。“至少”包括它，所以要有下面那条线：≥。

<.en: < means less than: smaller numbers only, the opposite of at least.
<.zh: < 是小于：只有更小的数，和“至少”相反。

questions.q: "You can bring at most 3 friends" is...

why.en: "At most 3" means 3 or FEWER: 3 is allowed but not 4. That is "less than or equal to": f ≤ 3.
why.zh: “最多 3 个”就是 3 个或更少：3 个可以，4 个不行。那是“小于或等于”：f ≤ 3。

f ≥ 3.en: ≥ means 3 or MORE (at least). At most means 3 or fewer.
f ≥ 3.zh: ≥ 是 3 或更多（至少）。“最多”是 3 或更少。

f < 3.en: < leaves out 3 itself, but you ARE allowed to bring 3 friends. So it needs the "or equal" line: ≤.
f < 3.zh: < 不包括 3，但你是可以带 3 个朋友的，所以要有“或等于”的线：≤。

f > 3.en: > means more than 3, which breaks the rule.
f > 3.zh: > 是超过 3 个，违反规定了。

questions.q: Which number is a solution of x > 5?

why.en: x > 5 means x must be GREATER than 5, and 5 itself is not included. 6 is greater than 5, so it works.
why.zh: x > 5 表示 x 必须大于 5，不包括 5 本身。6 大于 5，所以成立。

5.en: 5 is EQUAL to 5, not greater. The > sign does not include the number itself (no line underneath).
5.zh: 5 等于 5，不是大于。> 不包括这个数本身（下面没有线）。

4.en: 4 is less than 5, so 4 > 5 is false.
4.zh: 4 比 5 小，所以 4 > 5 不成立。

0.en: 0 is less than 5, so 0 > 5 is false.
0.zh: 0 比 5 小，所以 0 > 5 不成立。

questions.q: To graph x ≥ 2, you draw...
options: an open circle on 2 and an arrow to the right
a closed circle on 2 and an arrow to the right
a closed circle on 2 and an arrow to the left
an open circle on 2 and an arrow to the left

why.en: ≥ means "greater than OR EQUAL to", so 2 is included: a CLOSED (filled) circle on 2. Greater numbers are to the RIGHT on a number line, so the arrow goes right.
why.zh: ≥ 是“大于或等于”，包括 2：在 2 上画实心圆。数轴上越往右越大，所以箭头向右。

an open circle on 2 and an arrow to the.en: An open circle means 2 is NOT included. ≥ includes 2 (the "equal" line), so the circle must be closed.
an open circle on 2 and an arrow to the.zh: 空心圆表示不包括 2。≥ 包括 2（有“等于”的线），所以要用实心圆。

a closed circle on 2 and an arrow to the.en: Left means SMALLER numbers. ≥ means 2 and bigger, so the arrow goes right.
a closed circle on 2 and an arrow to the.zh: 向左是更小的数。≥ 是 2 和更大的数，所以箭头向右。

an open circle on 2 and an arrow to the.en: Both parts are wrong: that shows x < 2. Closed for ≥, and right for greater.
an open circle on 2 and an arrow to the.zh: 两部分都错了，那是 x < 2。≥ 用实心圆，大于向右。

questions.q: To graph x < 4, you draw...
options: a closed circle on 4 and an arrow to the left
an open circle on 4 and an arrow to the right
an open circle on 4 and an arrow to the left
a closed circle on 4 and an arrow to the right

why.en: < means "less than" with no "equal", so 4 is NOT included: an OPEN (empty) circle on 4. Smaller numbers are to the LEFT, so the arrow goes left.
why.zh: < 是“小于”，没有“等于”，不包括 4：在 4 上画空心圆。越往左越小，所以箭头向左。

a closed circle on 4 and an arrow to the.en: A closed circle means 4 IS included, which is ≤. The < sign has no equal line, so open.
a closed circle on 4 and an arrow to the.zh: 实心圆表示包括 4，那是 ≤。< 没有等于线，所以用空心圆。

an open circle on 4 and an arrow to the.en: Right means BIGGER numbers. Less than goes left.
an open circle on 4 and an arrow to the.zh: 向右是更大的数。小于要向左。

a closed circle on 4 and an arrow to the.en: Both parts are wrong: that shows x ≥ 4.
a closed circle on 4 and an arrow to the.zh: 两部分都错了，那是 x ≥ 4。

questions.q: A ride needs riders taller than 120 cm. Which inequality fits?

why.en: "Taller than 120" means MORE than 120, and exactly 120 is not enough. More than = greater than: h > 120.
why.zh: “高于 120”就是超过 120，刚好 120 不够。超过 = 大于：h > 120。

h < 120.en: < means shorter than 120. Those riders would NOT be allowed.
h < 120.zh: < 是比 120 矮，这些人不能坐。

h ≤ 120.en: ≤ means 120 or shorter, the opposite of the rule.
h ≤ 120.zh: ≤ 是 120 或更矮，和规定相反。

h = 120.en: = means exactly 120 only. Taller riders are allowed too, so it is an inequality, not an equation.
h = 120.zh: = 只表示刚好 120。更高的人也可以，所以要用不等式，不是等式。

canNow.en: I can now solve equations and write and graph inequalities.
canNow.zh: 我现在会解方程，会写和画不等式。

title.zh: 星期六作业：第 8 章练习

intro.en: Main Book M4 and M5 first. Check every answer by putting it back in.
intro.zh: 先看主课本 M4 和 M5。每个答案都代回去检查。

why.en: Undo "+ 9" with "− 9" on both sides: x = 15 − 9 = 6. Check: 6 + 9 = 15 ✓.

24.en: 24 is 15 + 9: it adds instead of undoing. Check: 24 + 9 = 33, not 15.

9.en: 9 is the number already in the equation. Check: 9 + 9 = 18, not 15.
9.zh: 9 是题目里本来的数。检查：9 + 9 = 18，不是 15。

15.en: 15 is the total, not x. Check: 15 + 9 = 24, not 15.

why.en: Undo "− 27" with "+ 27" on both sides: y = 13 + 27 = 40. Check: 40 − 27 = 13 ✓.

14.en: 14 is 27 − 13: it subtracts instead of undoing. Check: 14 − 27 is below zero, not 13.
14.zh: 14 是 27 − 13，减了而没有抵消。检查：14 − 27 小于 0，不是 13。

13.en: 13 is the answer side, not y. Check: 13 − 27 is below zero, not 13.
13.zh: 13 是等号右边的数，不是 y。检查：13 − 27 小于 0，不是 13。

27.en: 27 is the number taken away, not y. Check: 27 − 27 = 0, not 13.
27.zh: 27 是被减去的数，不是 y。检查：27 − 27 = 0，不是 13。

why.en: Undo "+ 16" with "− 16" on both sides: n = 25 − 16 = 9. Check: 9 + 16 = 25 ✓.

41.en: 41 is 25 + 16: it adds instead of undoing. Check: 41 + 16 = 57.

16.en: 16 is the number in the equation, not n. Check: 16 + 16 = 32.
16.zh: 16 是题目里的数，不是 n。检查：16 + 16 = 32。

why.en: 7k means 7 × k. Undo multiplying by 7 by dividing by 7: k = 63 ÷ 7 = 9. Check: 7 × 9 = 63 ✓.

56.en: 56 is 63 − 7. 7k is multiplication, so divide. Check: 7 × 56 = 392.

70.en: 70 is 63 + 7. 7k is multiplication, so divide. Check: 7 × 70 = 490.

questions.q: Is 15 a solution of 50 − x = 35?

why.en: A solution makes the equation TRUE. Put 15 in for x: 50 − 15 = 35, and 35 = 35 ✓. So yes.
why.zh: 解会让等式成立。把 15 代入 x：50 − 15 = 35，35 = 35 ✓。所以是。

No.en: Work it out: 50 − 15 = 35, which matches the right side exactly, so 15 IS a solution.
No.zh: 算一下：50 − 15 = 35，和右边完全一样，所以 15 是解。

questions.q: Tom spent 45 baht and has 55 baht left. Which equation finds how much he had (m)?

why.en: Follow the story in order: he HAD some money (m), SPENT 45 (− 45), and has 55 LEFT (= 55): m − 45 = 55. Solve: m = 55 + 45 = 100 baht.

m + 45 = 55.en: Plus means he GOT 45 more. Spending money takes it away, so minus.
m + 45 = 55.zh: 加号表示他又得到 45。花钱是减少，所以用减号。

45m = 55.en: 45m means 45 TIMES m. Spending is taking away, not multiplying.
45m = 55.zh: 45m 是 45 乘以 m。花钱是减，不是乘。

m − 55 = 45 + 55.en: This mixes up the numbers. 55 is what is LEFT, so it goes alone after the equals sign.
m − 55 = 45 + 55.zh: 这把数字弄乱了。55 是剩下的钱，应该单独放在等号后面。

questions.q: "More than 10 people" is...

why.en: "More than 10" means bigger than 10, with 10 itself NOT included (exactly 10 is not more than 10). So greater than: p > 10.
why.zh: “多于 10”就是比 10 大，不包括 10 本身（刚好 10 不算多于 10）。所以是大于：p > 10。

p ≥ 10.en: ≥ includes 10 itself. More than 10 does not include 10, so no equal line.
p ≥ 10.zh: ≥ 包括 10。多于 10 不包括 10，所以不要等于线。

p ≤ 10.en: ≤ means 10 or fewer: at most, the opposite.
p ≤ 10.zh: ≤ 是 10 或更少（最多），意思相反。

questions.q: Which number is NOT a solution of x ≤ 7?

why.en: x ≤ 7 means 7 or LESS. Test each one: 8 ≤ 7 is FALSE because 8 is bigger than 7. So 8 is the number that is NOT a solution.
why.zh: x ≤ 7 表示 7 或更小。一个一个试：8 ≤ 7 不成立，因为 8 比 7 大。所以 8 不是解。

7.en: 7 ≤ 7 is TRUE: the line under the sign means "or equal", so 7 is a solution.
7.zh: 7 ≤ 7 成立：符号下面的线表示“或等于”，所以 7 是解。

6.en: 6 is less than 7, so 6 ≤ 7 is true. It IS a solution.
6.zh: 6 比 7 小，6 ≤ 7 成立，它是解。

0.en: 0 is less than 7, so 0 ≤ 7 is true. It IS a solution.
0.zh: 0 比 7 小，0 ≤ 7 成立，它是解。

questions.q: An open circle on 3 with an arrow to the right shows...

why.en: Open circle = the number is NOT included, so no "equal" line. Arrow to the right = bigger numbers. Not including 3, bigger than 3: x > 3.
why.zh: 空心圆 = 不包括这个数，所以没有等于线。箭头向右 = 更大的数。不包括 3、比 3 大：x > 3。

x ≥ 3.en: ≥ includes 3, which would need a CLOSED circle.

x < 3.en: < means smaller numbers, so the arrow would point LEFT.
x < 3.zh: < 是更小的数，箭头会向左。

x ≤ 3.en: ≤ is smaller numbers AND includes 3: closed circle, arrow left. Both parts are wrong.
x ≤ 3.zh: ≤ 是更小的数而且包括 3：实心圆、向左。两部分都不对。

questions.q: A closed circle on 5 with an arrow to the left shows...

why.en: Closed circle = the number IS included, so use a sign with the "equal" line. Arrow to the left = smaller numbers. So 5 or less: x ≤ 5.
why.zh: 实心圆 = 包括这个数，所以用带等于线的符号。箭头向左 = 更小的数。所以 5 或更小：x ≤ 5。

x < 5.en: < does not include 5, which would be an OPEN circle.

x ≥ 5.en: ≥ means bigger numbers, so the arrow would point RIGHT.
x ≥ 5.zh: ≥ 是更大的数，箭头会向右。

x > 5.en: > is bigger numbers and excludes 5: open circle, arrow right. Both parts are wrong.
x > 5.zh: > 是更大的数而且不包括 5：空心圆、向右。两部分都不对。

canNow.en: I can now solve + and − equations and read inequality graphs.
canNow.zh: 我现在会解加减方程，会看不等式的图。

title.zh: 星期天作业：第 9 章练习

intro.en: Main Book M6 first. Look for the rule in each table.
intro.zh: 先看主课本 M6。找每个表格的规律。

questions.q: Sophie earns 40 baht for each hour she babysits. Which is the INDEPENDENT variable?

why.en: The INDEPENDENT variable is the one you change or choose first; it does not depend on anything. Sophie chooses how many hours to work, and the money DEPENDS on the hours. So hours is independent.
why.zh: 自变量是你先改变或选择的那个，它不依赖别的。Sophie 自己决定工作几小时，钱取决于小时数。所以小时是自变量。

money earned.en: Money DEPENDS on how many hours she works (more hours, more money), so money is the DEPENDENT variable.
money earned.zh: 钱取决于她工作几小时（越久钱越多），所以钱是因变量。

questions.q: The number of plants watered depends on the minutes James spends. The DEPENDENT variable is...

why.en: The DEPENDENT variable is the result that changes BECAUSE of the other one. The sentence says the plants watered "depend on" the minutes, so plants watered is dependent.
why.zh: 因变量是因为另一个变化而变化的结果。句子说浇的植物数量 depends on 分钟数，所以浇的植物是因变量。

minutes spent.en: James chooses the minutes; they cause the change. That makes minutes the INDEPENDENT variable.
minutes spent.zh: James 自己决定花几分钟，是它引起变化，所以分钟是自变量。

questions.q: x: 1, 2, 3. y: 4, 8, 12. The equation is...

why.en: Look for the rule that works for EVERY pair. 1 → 4, 2 → 8, 3 → 12: each y is x times 4. So y = 4x. Always test all the pairs, not just the first.
why.zh: 找对每一对都成立的规律。1 → 4，2 → 8，3 → 12：每个 y 都是 x 乘以 4。所以 y = 4x。要试每一对，不只是第一对。

y = x + 4.en: Test x = 1: 1 + 4 = 5, but y is 4. It fails at the very first pair.
y = x + 4.zh: 试 x = 1：1 + 4 = 5，但 y 是 4。第一对就不成立。

y = x + 3.en: Works for x = 1 (1 + 3 = 4) but fails for x = 2: 2 + 3 = 5, not 8. A rule must work for every pair.
y = x + 3.zh: x = 1 时成立（1 + 3 = 4），但 x = 2 时 2 + 3 = 5，不是 8。规律必须对每一对都成立。

questions.q: x: 1, 2, 3. y: 3, 5, 7. The equation is...

why.en: Each time x goes up by 1, y goes up by 2, so the rule has 2x. Then 2 × 1 = 2, and y is 3, so add 1: y = 2x + 1. Test all: 3, 5, 7 ✓.
why.zh: x 每加 1，y 就加 2，所以规律里有 2x。2 × 1 = 2，而 y 是 3，所以再加 1：y = 2x + 1。都试一遍：3、5、7 ✓。

y = x + 2.en: Works for x = 1 (3) but fails for x = 2: 2 + 2 = 4, not 5. A rule must work for every pair.
y = x + 2.zh: x = 1 时成立（3），但 x = 2 时 2 + 2 = 4，不是 5。规律必须对每一对都成立。

y = 3x.en: Works for x = 1 (3) but fails for x = 2: 3 × 2 = 6, not 5.

questions.q: y = 3x. If x = 12, y = ?

why.en: 3x means 3 × x. Replace x with 12: y = 3 × 12 = 36.

15.en: 15 is 3 + 12. But 3x means 3 TIMES x, not 3 plus x.
15.zh: 15 是 3 + 12。但 3x 是 3 乘以 x，不是 3 加 x。

312.en: 312 just writes 3 and 12 side by side. A number next to a letter means multiply: 3 × 12.
312.zh: 312 只是把 3 和 12 写在一起。数字挨着字母表示相乘：3 × 12。

questions.q: y = x + 5. If x = 9, y = ?

why.en: Replace x with 9 and do exactly what the rule says: y = 9 + 5 = 14.
why.zh: 把 x 换成 9，按规律算：y = 9 + 5 = 14。

45.en: 45 is 9 × 5. The rule says ADD 5, not multiply.

59.en: 59 just writes 5 and 9 side by side. The + sign means add: 9 + 5 = 14.
59.zh: 59 只是把 5 和 9 写在一起。+ 号表示加：9 + 5 = 14。

questions.q: On a graph, the independent variable goes on the...

why.en: The x-axis is the line going ACROSS (left to right). The independent variable (the one you choose, like hours) always goes across on the x-axis; the result goes up the y-axis.
why.zh: x 轴是横着的线（从左到右）。自变量（你选的，比如小时）总是放在横的 x 轴上；结果放在竖的 y 轴上。

y-axis.en: The y-axis (going UP) is for the DEPENDENT variable, the result that depends on the other.
y-axis.zh: y 轴（向上的）放因变量，就是依赖另一个的结果。

questions.q: To plot the point (2, 6), you go...

why.en: In a point (x, y), the FIRST number is x: go across. The SECOND number is y: go up. Think "walk to the lift, then go up": 2 across, then 6 up.
why.zh: 点 (x, y) 里第一个数是 x：横着走。第二个数是 y：往上走。想成“先走到电梯，再上楼”：先往右 2，再往上 6。

6 across, then 2 up.en: This swaps the numbers. That is the point (6, 2), a different place.
6 across, then 2 up.zh: 这把两个数换了，那是点 (6, 2)，是另一个位置。

2 up, then 6 across.en: Across always comes first. Going up first plots (6, 2) instead.
2 up, then 6 across.zh: 一定先横着走。先往上会画成 (6, 2)。

8 across.en: 2 + 6 = 8, but you never add the two numbers. They give two separate directions.
8 across.zh: 2 + 6 = 8，但两个数不能相加，它们是两个不同的方向。

questions.q: Which point is on the graph of y = 2x?

why.en: A point is on the graph if it makes the rule TRUE. Put x = 3 into y = 2x: y = 2 × 3 = 6. So (3, 6) works.
why.zh: 一个点在图上，就是它让规律成立。把 x = 3 代入 y = 2x：y = 2 × 3 = 6。所以 (3, 6) 成立。

(3, 5).en: With x = 3, y should be 2 × 3 = 6, not 5.
(3, 5).zh: x = 3 时 y 应该是 2 × 3 = 6，不是 5。

(6, 3).en: This is (3, 6) back to front. With x = 6, y = 2 × 6 = 12, not 3.

questions.q: A taxi costs 50 baht plus 10 baht for each km. Which equation gives the cost c for d km?

why.en: The amount that changes with each km gets the letter: 10 for EACH km = 10 × d = 10d. The 50 is paid once at the start, so it is added once: c = 10d + 50. (For 3 km: 30 + 50 = 80 baht.)
why.zh: 每公里都要付的钱跟着字母：每公里 10 = 10 × d = 10d。50 是开始时只付一次，所以只加一次：c = 10d + 50。（3 公里：30 + 50 = 80 泰铢。）

c = 50d + 10.en: This swaps the numbers: it charges 50 for every km. The per-km price is 10.
c = 50d + 10.zh: 这把两个数换了：每公里收 50。每公里的价钱是 10。

c = d + 60.en: This adds 50 and 10 together. But the 10 is paid for EACH km, so it must multiply d.
c = d + 60.zh: 这把 50 和 10 加在一起了。但 10 是每公里都要付，要乘以 d。

c = 60d.en: This charges 60 for every km. The 50 is paid only once, not for every km.
c = 60d.zh: 这样每公里收 60。50 只付一次，不是每公里都付。

canNow.en: I can now find variables, write equations from tables and read graphs.
canNow.zh: 我现在会找变量、从表格写方程、看图。

title.en: Class Quiz: Unit 8 and 9 Test Review
title.zh: 课堂小测：第 8、9 单元测验复习

intro.en: Practice for Tuesday's test. Show each step, then check.
intro.zh: 为星期二的测验练习。写出每一步，再检查。

why.en: Undo "+ 12" with "− 12" on both sides: x = 20 − 12 = 8. Check: 8 + 12 = 20 ✓.

32.en: 32 is 20 + 12: it adds instead of undoing. Check: 32 + 12 = 44.

12.en: 12 is the number in the equation. Check: 12 + 12 = 24.

why.en: Undo "− 9" with "+ 9" on both sides: p = 16 + 9 = 25. Check: 25 − 9 = 16 ✓.

7.en: 7 is 16 − 9: it subtracts again instead of undoing. Check: 7 − 9 is below zero.
7.zh: 7 是 16 − 9，又减了一次。检查：7 − 9 小于 0。

16.en: 16 is the answer side, not p. Check: 16 − 9 = 7.
16.zh: 16 是等号右边的数，不是 p。检查：16 − 9 = 7。

9.en: 9 is the number taken away. Check: 9 − 9 = 0.

why.en: 4a means 4 × a. Undo it by dividing by 4: a = 20 ÷ 4 = 5. Check: 4 × 5 = 20 ✓.

16.en: 16 is 20 − 4. 4a is multiplication, so divide. Check: 4 × 16 = 64.

questions.q: Which is an inequality?

why.en: An inequality compares two amounts that may NOT be equal, using >, <, ≥ or ≤. x ≥ 4 uses ≥, so it is an inequality.
why.zh: 不等式用 >、<、≥ 或 ≤ 比较两个不一定相等的量。x ≥ 4 用了 ≥，所以是不等式。

x = 4.en: The = sign makes it an EQUATION (both sides are equal).
x = 4.zh: = 号说明是等式（两边相等）。

x + 4.en: This is an EXPRESSION: it has no comparing sign at all.
x + 4.zh: 这是代数式，根本没有比较符号。

4x.en: 4x is an expression (4 times x). It has no comparing sign.
4x.zh: 4x 是代数式（4 乘 x），没有比较符号。

questions.q: "Fewer than 8 cookies" is...

why.en: "Fewer than 8" means less than 8, and 8 itself is NOT included (8 cookies is not fewer than 8). So c < 8, with no equal line.
why.zh: “少于 8”就是小于 8，不包括 8（8 块饼干不算少于 8）。所以 c < 8，没有等于线。

c ≤ 8.en: ≤ includes 8. Fewer than 8 does not include 8.

c ≥ 8.zh: ≥ 是 8 或更多，意思相反。

questions.q: Which number is a solution of x ≥ 10?

why.en: ≥ means greater than OR EQUAL to. The line under the sign means 10 itself counts: 10 ≥ 10 is true.
why.zh: ≥ 是大于或等于。符号下面那条线表示 10 本身也算：10 ≥ 10 成立。

9.en: 9 is less than 10, so 9 ≥ 10 is false.

5.en: 5 is less than 10, so 5 ≥ 10 is false.

0.en: 0 is less than 10, so 0 ≥ 10 is false.

questions.q: Hours studied and test score: the dependent variable is...

why.en: The DEPENDENT variable is the result. Your test score depends on how many hours you study, so the score is dependent.
why.zh: 因变量是结果。考试分数取决于学习了多少小时，所以分数是因变量。

hours studied.en: You choose the hours; they cause the change. That makes hours the INDEPENDENT variable.
hours studied.zh: 小时是你选的，是它引起变化，所以小时是自变量。

questions.q: x: 2, 4, 6. y: 1, 2, 3. The equation is...

why.en: Find a rule that works for EVERY pair: 2 → 1, 4 → 2, 6 → 3. Each y is half of x, so y = x ÷ 2.
why.zh: 找对每一对都成立的规律：2 → 1，4 → 2，6 → 3。每个 y 都是 x 的一半，所以 y = x ÷ 2。

y = 2x.en: That doubles x: x = 2 would give 4, not 1. Here y is SMALLER than x, so halve.
y = 2x.zh: 那是把 x 翻倍：x = 2 会得 4，不是 1。这里 y 比 x 小，所以是减半。

y = x − 1.en: Works for x = 2 (1) but fails for x = 4: 4 − 1 = 3, not 2.

why.en: Order of operations: multiply BEFORE adding. 5x = 5 × 3 = 15, then + 1 = 16.
why.zh: 运算顺序：先乘后加。5x = 5 × 3 = 15，再加 1 = 16。

15.en: 15 is only 5 × 3. You forgot the last step: + 1.

9.en: 9 is 5 + 3 + 1, adding instead of multiplying. 5x means 5 TIMES x.
9.zh: 9 是 5 + 3 + 1，把乘当成加了。5x 是 5 乘以 x。

53.en: 53 writes 5 and 3 side by side. 5x means 5 × 3.
53.zh: 53 是把 5 和 3 写在一起。5x 是 5 × 3。

why.en: Multiply first, then subtract: 2x = 2 × 6 = 12, then 12 − 5 = 7.

1.en: 1 is 6 − 5: it forgot to multiply by 2 first.

12.en: 12 is only 2 × 6. You forgot to subtract 5.

questions.q: The graph of y = 3x passes through...

why.en: A point is on the graph if it makes the rule true. Put x = 2 into y = 3x: 3 × 2 = 6. So (2, 6) works.
why.zh: 让规律成立的点才在图上。把 x = 2 代入 y = 3x：3 × 2 = 6。所以 (2, 6) 成立。

(6, 2).en: This is (2, 6) back to front. With x = 6, y = 3 × 6 = 18, not 2. The x number always comes first.
(6, 2).zh: 这是 (2, 6) 反过来了。x = 6 时 y = 18，不是 2。x 的数一定在前面。

questions.q: Which is the best first step for 3n = 27?

why.en: 3n means 3 × n. To get n alone, use the INVERSE operation of multiplying, which is dividing: divide both sides by 3. n = 27 ÷ 3 = 9.
why.zh: 3n 是 3 × n。要让 n 单独留下，用乘法的逆运算：除法。两边都除以 3：n = 27 ÷ 3 = 9。

subtract 3 from both sides.en: Subtracting undoes ADDING. Here 3 is multiplied by n, so divide.
subtract 3 from both sides.zh: 减法是用来抵消加法的。这里 3 是乘 n，所以要除。

multiply both sides by 3.en: That makes 9n, which moves further from n alone.
multiply both sides by 3.zh: 那样会变成 9n，离 n 单独更远了。

add 27 to both sides.en: Adding 27 does not undo anything; it just makes 3n + 27 = 54.
add 27 to both sides.zh: 加 27 什么都没抵消，只会变成 3n + 27 = 54。

canNow.en: I am ready for the Unit 8 and 9 test.
canNow.zh: 我已经准备好第 8、9 单元测验了。

title.en: End-of-Class Big Quiz: Chapter 8, Chapter 9 and the Atmosphere
title.zh: 课堂结束大测验：第 8 章、第 9 章和大气层

intro.en: Take this at the end of class. 25 questions: equations, inequalities, variables and graphs, and the atmosphere. Read every "why" when you get one wrong.
intro.zh: 下课前做。25 道题：方程、不等式、变量和图像，还有大气层。答错时要读每一条“原因”。

questions.q: Is 6 a solution of x + 9 = 15?

why.en: A solution makes the equation TRUE. Put 6 in for x: 6 + 9 = 15, and 15 = 15 ✓.

No.en: Work it out: 6 + 9 = 15, exactly the right side. So 6 IS a solution.
No.zh: 算一下：6 + 9 = 15，和右边一样，所以 6 是解。

why.en: Undo "+ 23" with "− 23" on both sides: y = 41 − 23 = 18. Check: 18 + 23 = 41 ✓.

64.en: 64 is 41 + 23: it adds instead of undoing. Check: 64 + 23 = 87.

23.en: 23 is the number already in the equation. Check: 23 + 23 = 46.
23.zh: 23 是题目里本来的数。检查：23 + 23 = 46。

why.en: Undo "− 14" with "+ 14" on both sides: k = 30 + 14 = 44. Check: 44 − 14 = 30 ✓.

16.en: 16 is 30 − 14: it subtracts again instead of undoing. Check: 16 − 14 = 2.

30.en: 30 is the answer side, not k. Check: 30 − 14 = 16.
30.zh: 30 是等号右边的数，不是 k。检查：30 − 14 = 16。

14.en: 14 is the number taken away. Check: 14 − 14 = 0.

why.en: 8n means 8 × n. Undo it by dividing both sides by 8: n = 72 ÷ 8 = 9. Check: 8 × 9 = 72 ✓.

64.en: 64 is 72 − 8. 8n is multiplication, so divide. Check: 8 × 64 = 512.

why.en: The inverse of dividing by 4 is multiplying by 4: p = 7 × 4 = 28. Check: 28 ÷ 4 = 7 ✓.

11.en: 11 is 7 + 4. Undo division with MULTIPLICATION. Check: 11 ÷ 4 is not 7.
11.zh: 11 是 7 + 4。除法要用乘法抵消。检查：11 ÷ 4 不是 7。

3.en: 3 is 7 − 4. Undo division with multiplication. Check: 3 ÷ 4 is less than 1.
3.zh: 3 是 7 − 4。除法要用乘法抵消。检查：3 ÷ 4 小于 1。

1.75.en: 1.75 is 7 ÷ 4: it divides again instead of undoing.
1.75.zh: 1.75 是 7 ÷ 4，又除了一次而没有抵消。

questions.q: Which is the best first step for x − 12 = 5?

why.en: x has 12 taken away. The inverse of subtracting 12 is ADDING 12, on both sides to keep it balanced: x = 5 + 12 = 17.
why.zh: x 被减去了 12。减 12 的逆运算是加 12，两边都加才保持平衡：x = 5 + 12 = 17。

subtract 12 from both sides.en: Subtracting 12 again makes x − 24, further from x alone.
subtract 12 from both sides.zh: 再减 12 会变成 x − 24，离 x 单独更远。

divide both sides by 12.en: Dividing undoes MULTIPLYING. Here 12 is subtracted.
divide both sides by 12.zh: 除法是抵消乘法的。这里 12 是被减去的。

add 5 to both sides.en: Adding 5 does not remove the − 12 next to x.
add 5 to both sides.zh: 加 5 不能去掉 x 旁边的 − 12。

questions.q: James had some marbles and lost 9. Now he has 16. Which equation fits?

why.en: Follow the story: he HAD m, LOST 9 (− 9), and now has 16 (= 16): m − 9 = 16. Solve: m = 16 + 9 = 25 marbles.

m + 9 = 16.en: Plus means he GOT 9 more. Losing marbles takes them away, so minus.
m + 9 = 16.zh: 加号表示他又得到 9 颗。丢了是减少，所以用减号。

9m = 16.en: 9m means 9 TIMES m. Losing is taking away, not multiplying.
9m = 16.zh: 9m 是 9 乘以 m。丢是减，不是乘。

m − 16 = 9 + 16.en: This mixes up the numbers. 16 is what he has NOW, so it goes alone after the equals sign.
m − 16 = 9 + 16.zh: 这把数字弄乱了。16 是他现在有的，应该单独放在等号后面。

questions.q: Which symbol means "at most"?

why.en: "At most 5" means 5 or LESS: 5 is allowed, 6 is not. That is "less than or equal to": ≤.
why.zh: “最多 5”就是 5 或更少：5 可以，6 不行。那是“小于或等于”：≤。

≥.en: ≥ means AT LEAST (that number or more), the opposite.
≥.zh: ≥ 是“至少”（这个数或更多），意思相反。

<.en: < leaves out the number itself, but "at most 5" allows exactly 5. It needs the equal line.
<.zh: < 不包括这个数本身，但“最多 5”可以刚好 5，要有等于线。

>.en: > means MORE than, the opposite of at most.

questions.q: "You must be at least 12 years old" is...

why.en: "At least 12" means 12 or MORE: a 12-year-old is allowed. Greater than OR equal to: a ≥ 12.
why.zh: “至少 12 岁”就是 12 岁或更大：12 岁可以。大于或等于：a ≥ 12。

a ≤ 12.en: ≤ means 12 or YOUNGER, the opposite of the rule.
a ≤ 12.zh: ≤ 是 12 岁或更小，和规定相反。

a > 12.en: > leaves out 12 itself, but a 12-year-old IS allowed. It needs the equal line: ≥.
a > 12.zh: > 不包括 12，但 12 岁是可以的，要有等于线：≥。

a < 12.zh: < 是小于 12 岁，意思相反。

questions.q: Which number is a solution of x < 6?

why.en: x < 6 means x must be LESS than 6, and 6 itself is not included. 5 is less than 6 ✓.
why.zh: x < 6 表示 x 必须小于 6，不包括 6。5 比 6 小 ✓。

6.en: 6 is EQUAL to 6, not less. The < sign has no equal line.
6.zh: 6 等于 6，不是小于。< 没有等于线。

7.en: 7 is bigger than 6, so 7 < 6 is false.

10.en: 10 is bigger than 6, so 10 < 6 is false.

questions.q: Which number is NOT a solution of y ≥ 4?

why.en: y ≥ 4 means 4 or MORE. Test each: 3 ≥ 4 is FALSE, because 3 is smaller than 4. So 3 is not a solution.
why.zh: y ≥ 4 表示 4 或更大。一个个试：3 ≥ 4 不成立，因为 3 比 4 小。所以 3 不是解。

4.en: 4 ≥ 4 is TRUE: the line under the sign means "or equal". So 4 IS a solution.
4.zh: 4 ≥ 4 成立：下面那条线表示“或等于”。所以 4 是解。

5.en: 5 is bigger than 4, so 5 ≥ 4 is true. It IS a solution.
5.zh: 5 比 4 大，5 ≥ 4 成立，它是解。

9.en: 9 is bigger than 4, so 9 ≥ 4 is true. It IS a solution.
9.zh: 9 比 4 大，9 ≥ 4 成立，它是解。

questions.q: An open circle on 2 and an arrow to the LEFT shows...

why.en: Open circle = 2 is NOT included (no equal line). Arrow left = smaller numbers. Not including 2, smaller than 2: x < 2.
why.zh: 空心圆 = 不包括 2（没有等于线）。箭头向左 = 更小的数。不包括 2、比 2 小：x < 2。

x ≤ 2.en: ≤ includes 2, which would need a CLOSED circle.

x > 2.en: > means bigger numbers, so the arrow would point RIGHT.
x > 2.zh: > 是更大的数，箭头会向右。

x ≥ 2.en: ≥ is bigger numbers AND includes 2: closed circle, arrow right. Both parts are wrong.
x ≥ 2.zh: ≥ 是更大的数而且包括 2：实心圆、向右。两部分都不对。

questions.q: To graph x ≥ 7, you draw...
options: an open circle on 7 and an arrow to the right
a closed circle on 7 and an arrow to the right
a closed circle on 7 and an arrow to the left
an open circle on 7 and an arrow to the left

why.en: ≥ includes 7 (the equal line), so a CLOSED circle. Greater numbers are to the RIGHT, so the arrow goes right.
why.zh: ≥ 包括 7（有等于线），所以画实心圆。更大的数在右边，所以箭头向右。

an open circle on 7 and an arrow to the.en: An open circle means 7 is NOT included. ≥ includes it, so closed.
an open circle on 7 and an arrow to the.zh: 空心圆表示不包括 7。≥ 包括它，所以要实心。

a closed circle on 7 and an arrow to the.en: Left means SMALLER numbers. ≥ is 7 and bigger, so right.
a closed circle on 7 and an arrow to the.zh: 向左是更小的数。≥ 是 7 和更大的，所以向右。

an open circle on 7 and an arrow to the.en: Both parts are wrong: that shows x < 7.
an open circle on 7 and an arrow to the.zh: 两部分都错了，那是 x < 7。

questions.q: Tom saves 20 baht every week. Which is the INDEPENDENT variable?

why.en: The independent variable is the one that changes on its own (time passing, or what you choose). The money saved DEPENDS on how many weeks have passed.
why.zh: 自变量是自己变化的那个（时间过去，或你选择的）。存的钱取决于过了几周。

money saved.en: The money depends on the weeks (more weeks, more money), so money is the DEPENDENT variable.
money saved.zh: 钱取决于周数（周越多，钱越多），所以钱是因变量。

questions.q: The number of cookies baked depends on the cups of flour used. The DEPENDENT variable is...

why.en: The sentence says the cookies "depend on" the flour. The thing that depends on the other is the dependent variable.
why.zh: 句子说饼干 depends on 面粉。依赖另一个的就是因变量。

cups of flour.en: The flour is what you choose; it causes the change. That makes it the INDEPENDENT variable.
cups of flour.zh: 面粉是你选的，是它引起变化，所以是自变量。

questions.q: x: 1, 2, 3. y: 6, 12, 18. The equation is...

why.en: Find a rule for EVERY pair: 1 → 6, 2 → 12, 3 → 18. Each y is x times 6, so y = 6x.
why.zh: 找对每一对都成立的规律：1 → 6，2 → 12，3 → 18。每个 y 都是 x 乘 6，所以 y = 6x。

y = x + 5.en: Works for x = 1 (6) but fails for x = 2: 2 + 5 = 7, not 12.

questions.q: x: 1, 2, 3. y: 4, 7, 10. The equation is...

why.en: Each time x goes up by 1, y goes up by 3, so the rule has 3x. Then 3 × 1 = 3, and y is 4, so add 1: y = 3x + 1. Test all: 4, 7, 10 ✓.
why.zh: x 每加 1，y 就加 3，所以规律里有 3x。3 × 1 = 3，而 y 是 4，所以加 1：y = 3x + 1。都试一遍：4、7、10 ✓。

y = x + 3.en: Works for x = 1 (4) but fails for x = 2: 2 + 3 = 5, not 7.

y = 4x.en: Works for x = 1 (4) but fails for x = 2: 4 × 2 = 8, not 7.

y = 3x.en: Test x = 1: 3 × 1 = 3, but y is 4. It needs + 1.

why.en: Multiply first, then subtract: 4x = 4 × 5 = 20, then 20 − 3 = 17.

2.en: 2 is 5 − 3: it forgot to multiply by 4 first.

20.en: 20 is only 4 × 5. You forgot to subtract 3.

questions.q: Which point is on the graph of y = x + 2?

why.en: A point is on the graph if it makes the rule TRUE. Put x = 3 into y = x + 2: 3 + 2 = 5. So (3, 5) works.
why.zh: 让规律成立的点才在图上。把 x = 3 代入 y = x + 2：3 + 2 = 5。所以 (3, 5) 成立。

(5, 3).en: This is (3, 5) back to front. With x = 5, y = 5 + 2 = 7, not 3. The x number always comes first.
(5, 3).zh: 这是 (3, 5) 反过来了。x = 5 时 y = 7，不是 3。x 的数一定在前面。

(3, 6).en: With x = 3, y = 3 + 2 = 5, not 6 (6 would be 2 × 3).

questions.q: To plot (5, 3), you go...

why.en: In (x, y) the first number is x: go ACROSS. The second is y: go UP. So 5 across, then 3 up.
why.zh: (x, y) 里第一个数是 x：横着走。第二个是 y：往上走。所以先往右 5，再往上 3。

3 across, then 5 up.en: This swaps the numbers and plots (3, 5), a different point.
3 across, then 5 up.zh: 这把两个数换了，画出来是 (3, 5)，是另一个点。

5 up, then 3 across.en: Across always comes first. Going up first plots (3, 5).
5 up, then 3 across.zh: 一定先横着走。先往上会画成 (3, 5)。

8 across.en: 5 + 3 = 8, but you never add the two numbers. They are two separate directions.
8 across.zh: 5 + 3 = 8，但两个数不能相加，它们是两个不同的方向。

questions.q: A phone plan costs 100 baht plus 5 baht for each GB. Which equation gives the cost c for g GB?

why.en: The amount for EACH GB gets the letter: 5 × g = 5g. The 100 is paid once, so it is added once: c = 5g + 100. (For 10 GB: 50 + 100 = 150 baht.)
why.zh: 每 GB 都要付的钱跟着字母：5 × g = 5g。100 只付一次，所以只加一次：c = 5g + 100。（10 GB：50 + 100 = 150 泰铢。）

c = 100g + 5.en: This swaps the numbers: it charges 100 for every GB. The per-GB price is 5.
c = 100g + 5.zh: 这把两个数换了：每 GB 收 100。每 GB 的价钱是 5。

c = g + 105.en: This adds 100 and 5 together. But the 5 is paid for EACH GB, so it must multiply g.
c = g + 105.zh: 这把 100 和 5 加在一起了。但 5 是每 GB 都要付，要乘以 g。

c = 105g.en: This charges 105 for every GB. The 100 is paid only once.
c = 105g.zh: 这样每 GB 收 105。100 只付一次。

questions.q: Which gas is about 21% of the air?

why.en: Air is about 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen and 1% other gases. The 21% is oxygen, the gas we breathe.
why.zh: 空气大约 78% 是氮气，21% 是氧气，1% 是其他气体。21% 是氧气，就是我们呼吸的气体。

nitrogen.en: Nitrogen is the BIGGEST part, about 78%.

carbon dioxide.en: Carbon dioxide is a tiny part of the air, well under 1%.
carbon dioxide.zh: 二氧化碳只占很小一部分，远少于 1%。

argon.en: Argon is part of the last 1% of other gases.
argon.zh: 氩气属于最后 1% 的其他气体。

questions.q: Which layer of the atmosphere do we live in?

why.en: The troposphere starts at the ground and goes up about 12 km. We live in it, and all weather happens in it.
why.zh: 对流层从地面开始，大约到 12 公里高。我们生活在这一层，所有天气都在这里发生。

stratosphere.en: The stratosphere is the SECOND layer, above the weather, where the ozone layer is.
stratosphere.zh: 平流层是第二层，在天气上面，臭氧层在那里。

mesosphere.en: The mesosphere is the THIRD layer, where meteors burn up.
mesosphere.zh: 中间层是第三层，流星在那里烧掉。

thermosphere.en: The thermosphere is the FOURTH layer, very high up.

questions.q: The ozone layer protects us by absorbing...

why.en: Ozone in the stratosphere soaks up most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays, which can burn skin.
why.zh: 平流层的臭氧吸收了大部分太阳的有害紫外线，紫外线会晒伤皮肤。

rain.en: Rain falls in the troposphere, BELOW the ozone layer.
rain.zh: 雨在对流层，在臭氧层下面。

meteors.en: Meteors burn up higher, in the mesosphere, because of friction with the air.
meteors.zh: 流星在更高的中间层因为和空气摩擦而烧掉。

wind.en: Wind is in the troposphere. Ozone blocks rays from the Sun, not moving air.
wind.zh: 风在对流层。臭氧挡的是太阳射线，不是流动的空气。

questions.q: The correct order from the ground up is...

why.en: From the ground up: T, S, M, T, E. Remember "The Strong Man Throws Eggs".
why.zh: 从地面往上：T、S、M、T、E。记住 The Strong Man Throws Eggs。

stratosphere, troposphere, mesosphere, t.en: The first two are swapped. The troposphere (weather) is always at the bottom.
stratosphere, troposphere, mesosphere, t.zh: 前两个换了。对流层（天气层）一定在最下面。

troposphere, mesosphere, stratosphere, t.en: Mesosphere and stratosphere are swapped. Strong Man: S comes before M.
troposphere, mesosphere, stratosphere, t.zh: 中间层和平流层换了。Strong Man：S 在 M 前面。

exosphere, thermosphere, mesosphere, str.en: This is the right list but from the TOP down.

canNow.en: I can now solve equations and inequalities, find rules in tables and graphs, and name the layers of the atmosphere.
canNow.zh: 我现在会解方程和不等式，会找表格和图像的规律，还能说出大气层的各层。

title.en: Day 1 Maths: Undo It! × and ÷ Equations
title.zh: 第 1 天数学：乘除方程

items.q: Solve 5k = 35. What happens to k? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: k is multiplied by 5, so divide both sides by 5: 35 ÷ 5 = 7.
why.zh: k 被乘以 5，所以两边除以 5：35 ÷ 5 = 7。

items.q: Solve y ÷ 3 = 8. What happens to y? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: y is divided by 3, so multiply both sides by 3: 8 × 3 = 24.
why.zh: y 被除以 3，所以两边乘以 3：8 × 3 = 24。

items.q: Solve 9p = 72. What happens to p? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: p is multiplied by 9, so divide both sides by 9: 72 ÷ 9 = 8.
why.zh: p 被乘以 9，所以两边除以 9：72 ÷ 9 = 8。

items.q: Solve w ÷ 6 = 7. What happens to w? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: w is divided by 6, so multiply both sides by 6: 7 × 6 = 42.
why.zh: w 被除以 6，所以两边乘以 6：7 × 6 = 42。

items.q: Solve 12a = 144. What happens to a? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: a is multiplied by 12, so divide both sides by 12: 144 ÷ 12 = 12.
Do the opposite of ÷ 5: 11 × 5 = 55.

items.q: Emma pays 60 baht for 4 notebooks. Which equation finds the price p of one?

why.en: 4 notebooks × p baht = 60 baht. (Then p = 15 baht.)
why.zh: 4 本 × p 泰铢 = 60 泰铢。（所以 p = 15 泰铢。）

items.q: Tom solved 7r = 56 and wrote r = 392. What did he do wrong?
items.right: B) He multiplied by 7. He should divide.

why.en: 56 × 7 = 392. The opposite of × 7 is ÷ 7, so r = 56 ÷ 7 = 8.

options: B) He multiplied by 7. He should divide.

title.zh: 第 1 天英语：单词分类

items.q: Which words go in the Sea and Animals group?

why.en: They are about the sea or animals.
why.zh: 它们和海洋或动物有关。

items.q: Which words go in the People and Feelings group?

why.en: They describe people and how they feel.
why.zh: 它们描述人和感受。

items.q: Which words go in the Science and Numbers group?
items.right: ecologist, dissolve, classify, disruption, billion, neurons

why.en: They are science or number words.
why.zh: 它们是科学或数字的词。

items.q: A perplexing maths problem makes you feel...

why.en: Perplexing = confusing.
why.zh: perplexing = 令人困惑的。

items.q: Sugar ________ in hot tea.

why.en: Dissolve = mix into a liquid and disappear.
why.zh: dissolve = 溶解。

items.q: Which animal can have venom?

why.en: Some snakes make venom (poison).
why.zh: 有些蛇有毒液。

items.q: How many zeros are in one billion (1,000,000,000)?

why.en: Count them: 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.

items.q: Neurons carry messages between...
items.right: A) the brain and the body

why.en: Neurons are nerve cells.
why.zh: 神经元是神经细胞。

options: A) the brain and the body
B) the sea and the sky
D) a tree and its leaves

items.q: A dolphin in captivity...
items.right: B) lives in a tank and cannot leave

why.en: Captivity = kept somewhere and not allowed to leave.
why.zh: captivity = 被关着，不能离开。

options: B) lives in a tank and cannot leave
D) is a kind of coral

items.q: Write ONE sentence about yourself with the word "confident".
items.right: Example: I feel confident when I sing in front of my friends.

why.en: Any sentence is fine if it uses confident correctly, starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
why.zh: 只要正确使用 confident，大写开头、句号结尾，都可以。

title.zh: 第 2 天数学：小数和分数

items.q: 1/4 k = 5. 1 part = 5. k is 4 parts, so k = 4 × 5 = ?

why.en: 1 part is 5, and k is all 4 parts: 4 × 5 = 20. Check: 1/4 of 20 = 5.
12 ÷ 3 = 4, then 4 parts × 4 = 16. Check: 3/4 of 16 = 12.

items.q: 0.5x = 7. 0.5 is a half. Half of x is 7, so x = ?  Check: 0.5 × ? = 7

why.en: Half of x is 7, so x is double 7: 14.
why.zh: x 的一半是 7，所以 x 是 7 的两倍：14。

2 parts = 8, so 1 part = 4. h = 5 × 4 = 20.

items.q: Sophie ran 3/4 of a race. She ran 600 m. How long is the whole race?

why.en: 3 parts = 600 m, so 1 part = 200 m. 4 parts = 800 m.

items.q: Jack says the answer to 2/3 n = 12 is n = 8. Is he right?

why.en: 2 parts = 12, so 1 part = 6. n = 3 × 6 = 18. Jack found 2/3 of 12 instead.

title.zh: 第 2 天英语：is 还是 are？

items.q: Emma ________ a confident swimmer.

why.en: Emma = one person: is.
why.zh: 一个：is。

items.q: Sharks ________ saltwater fish.

why.en: Sharks = more than one: are.
why.zh: 多于一个：are。

items.q: The coral reef ________ full of colour.

why.en: The reef = one thing: is.
why.zh: 一个：is。

items.q: Neurons ________ tiny cells in your body.

why.en: Neurons = more than one: are.
why.zh: 多于一个：are。

items.q: James and Tom ________ ecologists.

why.en: Two people: are.
why.zh: 多于一个：are。

items.q: This puzzle ________ so perplexing!

why.en: One puzzle: is.
why.zh: 一个：is。

items.q: There ________ more than a billion people in China.

why.en: The subject is people (more than one): are.
why.zh: 多于一个：are。

items.q: The box of shells ________ on the table. (Careful!)

why.en: Trap! The subject is the BOX (one): is.
why.zh: 陷阱！主语是 box（一个）：is。

items.q: Which sentence is correct?
items.right: C) The animals in the zoo are in captivity.

why.en: Animals = more than one: are.
why.zh: animals 多于一个：are。

options: C) The animals in the zoo are in captivity.

items.q: Which sentence is correct?
items.right: B) Each fish is a different colour.

why.en: Each = one at a time: is.
why.zh: each = 每一个：is。

options: A) Lily and Mia is sisters.
B) Each fish is a different colour.

items.q: Write 2 sentences about your family: one with is, one with are.
items.right: Example: My dad is funny. My cousins are in Beijing.

why.en: One person or thing: is. More than one: are.
why.zh: 一个：is。多于一个：are。

title.zh: 第 3 天科学：轻松学天气

items.q: Weather is like your ________; climate is like your ________.

why.en: Weather changes daily like an outfit. Climate is over many years like a wardrobe.
why.zh: 天气每天变，像衣服；气候是多年的，像衣柜。

items.q: "Bangkok is hot and wet for most of the year." This sentence is about...

why.en: "Most of the year" = a long time = climate.
why.zh: “一年中大部分时间” = 长时间 = 气候。

items.q: Why is an air mass like a giant sponge?
items.right: A) It soaks up the heat and wetness of the place it sits over.

why.en: Like a sponge soaks up water.
why.zh: 像海绵吸水一样。

options: A) It soaks up the heat and wetness of the place it sits over.
B) It is yellow and soft.

items.q: At a cold front, warm air is pushed up...

why.en: The bulldozer pushes warm air up fast.
why.zh: 推土机把暖空气快速推上去。

items.q: A cold front often brings...

why.en: Short, heavy rain and thunderstorms.
why.zh: 短时大雨和雷暴。

items.q: Which comparison matches a warm front?

why.en: Warm air slides gently up like a ramp.
why.zh: 暖空气像走斜坡一样慢慢滑上去。

items.q: Water drops on a cold can of drink are an example of...

why.en: Water vapour turns back into water.
why.zh: 水蒸气变回水。

items.q: TEST TIP: Which question word tells you to give a REASON?

why.en: "Explain why" asks for a reason. Use because.
why.zh: Explain why 要求给出原因，用 because。

items.q: Explain why clouds form high in the sky. Use the word "because".
items.right: Example: Clouds form high in the sky because the air cools down and the water vapour condenses into tiny water drops.

why.en: Your answer needs: air cools + water vapour turns into water drops (condensation) + because.
why.zh: 答案要有：空气变冷 + 水蒸气变成小水滴（凝结）+ because。
